        "code": "182: def _atomic_write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
183:     """Replace *path* without ever exposing a half-written manifest.
184: 
185:     A reader that catches the file mid-write would see truncated JSON and treat
186:     the whole space as corrupt, so the new content lands under a temp name in the
187:     same directory and is renamed over — atomic on every filesystem ken runs on.
188:     """
189:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
190:     fd, tmp = tempfile.mkstemp(dir=str(path.parent), prefix=path.name, suffix=".tmp")
191:     try:
192:         with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
193:             fh.write(text)
194:             fh.flush()
195:             os.fsync(fh.fileno())
196:         # mkstemp creates at 0600 and os.replace keeps that mode, so the
197:         # manifest would end up stricter than the segments beside it, which are
198:         # created through open() and follow the umask. On a shared `.ken/` — CI,
199:         # a container running as another uid — that reads the store as absent
200:         # rather than as unreadable, and the caller falls back silently instead
201:         # of reporting anything.
202:         try:
203:             os.chmod(tmp, 0o666 & ~_process_umask())
204:         except OSError:
205:             pass
206:         os.replace(tmp, path)
207:     except BaseException:
208:         Path(tmp).unlink(missing_ok=True)
209:         raise"
      }
    ]
  }
}

item.text:
- **Destino:** `root/KEN_DIR_NAME/vectors/<space>.json`, construido por [`_paths.ken_dir`](/private/tmp/ken-contract-agent-context-20260921/project/src/ken/_paths.py:27), [`vectors_dir`](/private/tmp/ken-contract-agent-context-20260921/project/src/ken/vectors.py:169) y [`VectorStore.manifest_path`](/private/tmp/ken-contract-agent-context-20260921/project/src/ken/vectors.py:376).
- **Escritor:** [`_atomic_write`](/private/tmp/ken-contract-agent-context-20260921/project/src/ken/vectors.py:182) crea un temporal en el mismo directorio, escribe, ejecuta `flush` y `fsync`, intenta `chmod(0o666 & ~umask)` y después llama a `os.replace`. [`_process_umask`](/private/tmp/ken-contract-agent-context-20260921/project/src/ken/vectors.py:175) obtiene la máscara estableciendo temporalmente `022` y restaurando el valor anterior.
- **Caller:** [`VectorStore._load_or_create`](/private/tmp/ken-contract-agent-context-20260921/project/src/ken/vectors.py:379) llama al escritor al crear el manifiesto; si ya existe, lo lee sin corregir permisos.

Esto describe **código observado**, no permisos garantizados en ejecución: se ignora `OSError` de `chmod`. El chequeo registrado solo confirma la presencia de esa llamada, no su éxito ni la atomicidad efectiva del sistema de archivos.
